messages:
IncidentBot: Pager fired: inference-runtime P99 latency spike for region eu-west-1 on dedicated pool 7 at 3335100000
Maya R.: saw it, joining. linking traces now.
Ken S.: jump in — I'm running a quick tail on the runtime pod logs. suspect kvcache lookups timing out.
Priya N.: customer impact check: a few customers reported increased 504s, no data exfiltration. I'm pulling support tickets now.
Omar G.: stack traces show repeated: 
```
ERROR runtime::kv_cache - get_prefix failed: timeout after 250ms (key=chat:conv:1234)
WARN runtime::batcher - dropped 8 requests due to backpressure
```
Lucia V.: are we seeing this after any rollout? last deploy 3335097000 was a model runtime tweak (quantization kernel swap).
Maya R.: correct — deploy included new INT8 dispatch for attention kernels. rolling back?
Ken S.: can we quickly repro locally with the same sequence length distribution? I'm spinning a small test harness.
OncallAlex: oncall handoff in 20m — please capture mitigation steps and owners. I'll be available for customer comms.
Priya N.: customers flagged latency spikes ~08:12-08:19 UTC. tally: ~6 support tickets, 2 live chats escalated. flagged as degraded.
Omar G.: mitigation idea: disable the new quant kernel on those dedicated nodes via runtime feature flag and revert kv cache timeout to 500ms. low-risk?
Lucia V.: feature flag exists: `runtime.use_new_int8` — can flip per-pool. patch: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/internal/pool/7/flags -d '{"runtime.use_new_int8": false}'`
Maya R.: initiating flag flip now. will monitor tail.
Ken S.: flipping. response: 200 OK.
Maya R.: logs: `kv_cache` timeouts dropping, batcher backpressure clearing, p99 dropping in next 30s.
IncidentBot: Auto-update: Incident severity downgraded to SEV-2 at 3335100120 (reduced customer impact).
Priya N.: creating postmortem and scheduling follow-up. Proposed title: "Regression from quant kernel swap caused KV cache timeouts" — open to better wording.
OncallAlex: please create an incident doc and assign postmortem owner. I'll handle customer emails (SOC template).
Maya R.: I'll file the postmortem and own follow-ups. PT: maya.r@redwood. Issue tracker: INC-7642.
Ken S.: action items: (1) revert/stabilize quant kernel across dedicated pools (owner: Ken, due: 3335103600) ; (2) KV cache timeout tuning + metric alerts (owner: Omar, due: 3335107200) ; (3) add e2e perf test for new kernel under high prefix-cache-stress (owner: Priya, due: 3335110800) ; (4) run canary with synthetic traffic ramp (owner: Lucia, due: 3335114400).
Omar G.: I'll add dashboards for prefixed cache hit latency and add SLO burn alerts. saving runbook snippet: 
```
# quick mitigation steps
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/internal/pool/{pool_id}/flags -d '{"runtime.use_new_int8": false}'
kubectl rollout restart ds/runtime-pool-{pool_id}
# to revert timeout
PATCH /config/kv_cache {"timeout_ms":500}
```
Priya N.: adding a test harness job: `ci/regressions/quant-kv-stress` with sequence distribution + parallel requests. will land infra PR and schedule overnight runs.
Lucia V.: can we also add a small-rate limiter during kernel rollout to avoid saturating the batcher?
Ken S.: good idea — add `batcher.max_inflight_per_worker` temporary cap when flipping kernels.
Maya R.: postmortem meeting: propose 3335105400 (UTC) tomorrow for 60m. attendees: eng-runtime, infra, oncall, product ops. I'll add calendar invite.
OncallAlex: handoff note: I will be primary for customer comms until 3335101800. After that, Maya takes over.
Priya N.: logging checklist for postmortem: collect traces for 07:50-08:30 window, support ticket IDs, sample requests that hit cache misses, kernel version hashes.
Ken S.: tagging PRs that introduced quant kernel change: #9123 and runtime-kernel#458. will prepare a rollback playbook and push to repo under ops/playbooks/kern-rollbacks.md.
Maya R.: updating INC-7642 with timeline and current mitigations. assigning owners per action items.
IncidentBot: Reminder: Postmortem due in 7 days for SEV-2 incidents.
Omar G.: quick note: we should also consider adaptive KV cache timeouts based on observed queue depth — filing a follow-up ticket (RWF-321).
Lucia V.: nice. will coordinate canary config and throttling strategy with infra team.
Maya R.: thanks team. immediate state: mitigated, customers notified, postmortem created, owners assigned. leaving thread for async updates. :white_check_mark:
OncallAlex: 👍 will follow up on customer replies and escalate if any regressions reappear.
Maya R.: marking thread resolved in our tracker at 3335100900.
